Subject: Starlix MAP kickoff — proposed window and first pass of attendees

Hi Holly / Devon —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. We'd like to lock in a quick 60-minute MAP (mutual action plan) kickoff next week to align on objectives, success criteria, evaluation plan, and roles for the pilot. Goal of the meeting: agree on milestones and owners so we can hit your close timeline in Q3.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue June 2: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed June 3: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00

Attendees we suggest from your side: a product sponsor, a lead ML/infra contact, and an IT/security reviewer (SOC 2 & network). From our side we'll include: Marcus (deployment & ops), Lauren (customer success / evals), and myself.

I've attached a first-pass MAP draft and a kickoff agenda to help frame the conversation. Can you confirm who should attend and which of the times above works best?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
